evals.name: hilt-network-module
evals.expected_output: Annotations output (Hilt source). Progressive: Koin set up alongside Hilt (koin-dagger-bridge or a co-located bridge), Hilt untouched elsewhere. NetworkModule becomes a Koin @Module class (in a .di package) with @Singleton fun builders for OkHttpClient, Retrofit and ApiService — function builders, no classic single { } lambdas. The custom @AuthInterceptor qualifier is reused as-is (JSR-330 compatible), not turned into named("auth"). @HiltViewModel → @KoinViewModel with SavedStateHandle injected automatically; hiltViewModel() → koinViewModel(). Start: @KoinApplication + startKoin<App> { androidContext(...) }, module discovered via @Module @Configuration @ComponentScan("<feature package>"). Gradle per gradle.md with versions checked on Maven Central. Verification: build (compile-time graph check), no checkModules. Per-module validation then ask the user before the next module; Kotzilla offered at the validation step, asking first. No @Single (uses @Singleton), no viewModelOf, no KSP.

evals.name: dagger-subcomponents-scopes
evals.prompt: We have a legacy Android app using Dagger 2 with subcomponents for user sessions. The AppComponent creates a UserSessionSubcomponent when the user logs in, which provides UserRepository and SessionManager scoped to the session lifetime. When the user logs out, the subcomponent is destroyed. How do I migrate this to Koin while keeping the same scoping behavior?
evals.expected_output: Should follow 8-step workflow. Step 1: Inventory AppComponent + UserSessionSubcomponent bindings. Step 2: Plan mapping subcomponent → scope<T>, @SessionScope → scope<UserSessionScope>{}. Step 3: Gradle remove Dagger, add Koin. Step 4: Generate scope<UserSessionScope>{ scoped{SessionManager(get())} scoped{UserRepository(get())} }. Step 5: startKoin setup. Step 6: Replace component.inject() with by inject(), createScope on login, scope.close() on logout. Step 7: Test with KoinTestRule. Step 8: Checklist.

evals.name: koin3-to-koin4-kmp
evals.prompt: I'm upgrading our KMP project from Koin 3.5 to Koin 4. We have common modules and platform-specific modules for Android and iOS. We also use koin-annotations with KSP. What do I need to change?
evals.expected_output: Inventory first: which modules are Koin DSL and which use koin-annotations with KSP. Annotated code stays Annotations — KSP replaced by the Compiler Plugin (ksp-to-compiler checklist: remove ksp plugin, koin-ksp-compiler, generated-code imports, AppModule().module → discovery or module<T>()). DSL modules move to Safe DSL: singleOf(::T) → single<T>(), factoryOf → factory<T>(), viewModelOf → viewModel<VM>(), function builders or lambdas only for third-party types — keeping one style per module. Gradle: Compiler Plugin + koin-bom, latest checked on Maven Central (≥ 4.2.2 / 1.2.1), Kotlin ≥ 2.3.20 with the Kotlin-bump cascade checked; shared artifacts in commonMain. KMP: one shared initApp() in commonMain called by Android and iOS; platform modules with expect/actual. Compose: getViewModel → koinViewModel (koin-compose-viewmodel), get() → koinInject(); no KoinContext. Verification: compile-time graph check, existing checkModules() tests removed. Progressive, module by module, with user acknowledgement between modules.

evals.name: toothpick-full-migration
evals.prompt: We have a legacy Android app still using Toothpick for DI. It uses KTP.openScopes with a scope tree: Application → Activity → Fragment. Each scope has its own Toothpick Module with bind().to() and bind().toInstance(). We also have @Inject field injection everywhere and a custom ViewModelProvider.Factory wired through Toothpick. How do I migrate all of this to Koin?
evals.expected_output: Annotations output (Toothpick source). Progressive: Koin alongside Toothpick, leaf modules first, ack between modules. bind().to() → @Singleton / @Factory on the implementation, auto-bound to its single interface; toInstance → @Singleton fun builder in a @Module. Scope tree: Application → root definitions; Activity / Fragment scopes → @ActivityScope / @FragmentScope (or activityScope { } / fragmentScope { }), components implementing AndroidScopeComponent with `override val scope by activityScope()` / `fragmentScope()`. Asks whether those scoped instances really need sharing (scopes only when needed). @Inject field injection: in Activities / Fragments → by inject() / by viewModel(); in normal classes → constructor injection (no KoinComponent). Custom ViewModelProvider.Factory removed → @KoinViewModel + koinViewModel() / by viewModel(). Start: @KoinApplication + startKoin<App>. Tests: ToothPickRule → KoinTestRule. Verification: compile-time check, no checkModules. Final cleanup removes toothpick / smoothie and every bridge. No singleOf, no @Single, no KoinScopeComponent on Activities.

evals.name: koin-dsl-to-safe-dsl
evals.expected_output: Keeps the DSL style and the module { } structure; converts to Safe DSL. dataModule: AppDatabase.create() and userDao() are custom expressions → function builders (single { create(::buildDatabase) }) or kept lambdas; singleOf(::UserRepository) with bind → single<UserRepository>().withOptions { bind<Repository>() } (or .bind<Repository>()); factory with a runtime param → factory<DataSync>() with @InjectedParam on DataSync's parameter. viewModelModule: viewModelOf(::MainViewModel) → viewModel<MainViewModel>(), viewModel { DetailViewModel(get(), get()) } → viewModel<DetailViewModel>(). Named qualifiers: @Named on the class or constructor parameter with plain single<T>(); named() only kept on lambdas. Gradle: Compiler Plugin + koin-bom, latest checked on Maven Central, Kotlin ≥ 2.3.20. Start: one app module including the feature modules. Verification: compile-time graph check — no checkModules() test. Existing classic lines that don't need converting may stay; no annotations introduced.

evals.name: ksp-to-compiler-plugin
evals.expected_output: Should follow 8-step workflow. Step 1: Inventory existing KSP annotations and modules. Step 2: Plan — mostly Gradle changes, minimal code changes (@KoinViewModel import). Step 3: Gradle — remove KSP plugin, remove ksp() dependency, remove ksp{} block, add io.insert-koin.compiler.plugin (latest, ≥ 1.2.1), update all Koin deps via the BOM (latest, ≥ 4.2.2). Step 4: Code changes — update @KoinViewModel import from org.koin.android.annotation to org.koin.core.annotation, remove import org.koin.ksp.generated.module, optionally update DSL to single<T>() style. Step 5: Application wiring stays same. Step 6: Minimal injection site changes. Step 7: Tests with updated deps. Step 8: Checklist including delete build/generated/ksp/, verify K2 compilation.

evals.name: ksp-to-compiler-kmp

Step 3: Gradle — remove KSP plugin, ALL per-target ksp() dependencies, source set hack, task dependency hack; add single io.insert-koin.compiler.plugin; update Koin to the latest release (≥ 4.2.2).
